entries.06aa12f492f4af98: A company that handles multifunction printers and digital printing presses, as well as measuring instruments, display films and medical diagnostic imaging systems, around the world.
entries.12612c42041e7f51: This business develops, manufactures and sells video-related equipment, and provides related solutions and services. Revenue increased from the previous year in the fiscal year ended March 2026. The company explains that its directly operated planetarium theaters and equipment sales performed well.
entries.1c56b05733e73df3: This business develops, manufactures and sells digital printing systems and related consumables, and provides various printing services and solutions, for the commercial printing market. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 declined from the previous year due to the impact of a share transfer, but the company explains that, excluding the impact, it was in line with the previous year. Consumables, services and others grew, centered on Europe and India.
entries.1d5d24581115d507: In addition to measuring instruments, this business manufactures components and devices used within other companies' products, such as functional films used in displays, industrial inkjet heads, and industrial and professional lenses. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥126,779 million, up from ¥119,259 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025. Of the four reportable segments, this is the only one whose revenue increased from the previous year.
entries.1ec9f9254c0d3734: This business develops, manufactures and sells digital printing systems and related consumables, and provides various printing services and solutions, for the industrial printing market. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥255,180 million, down from ¥284,668 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025. The company explains that the transfer of shares in Konica Minolta Marketing Services Holding Company Limited had a large impact. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, the Marketing Services Unit is presented as integrated into the Production Print Unit.
entries.262f1909dbb714d9: This business develops and sells products, information systems and services for nursing care operations, and provides consulting. The business content is described in the notes on business segments. The analysis of operating results does not include a separate explanation of this unit alone.
entries.334d18468df8af43: Products, Information Systems and Services for Nursing Care Operations
entries.48ad1275f559abb1: This business develops, manufactures and sells digital printing systems and related consumables for the industrial printing market. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 increased from the previous year. Sales of the printing machines themselves fell because deals were prolonged by the impact of U.S. tariffs, but consumables, services and others increased.
entries.4e36a861b7d5700b: This business develops, manufactures and sells functional films and other products used in displays. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 increased from the previous year. The company explains that demand for films was firm in both large areas such as TVs and small-to-medium areas such as smartphones, and that sales expanded centered on large IPS-mode liquid crystal displays.
entries.60f209db7ab52924: This business provides IT services and solutions. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 declined from the previous year due to the impact of the transfer of part of the business as part of the selection and focus of businesses, but the company explains that revenue increased if the impact of the transfer is excluded. Services providing business content management and business process management in Europe, and the company's in-house developed AI SaaS business in Japan, performed well.
entries.65759944729e603b: This category is not included in the four reportable segments. Revenue from external customers was ¥725 million in the fiscal year ended March 2026, compared with ¥674 million in the fiscal year ended March 2025. The business content section lists Konica Minolta Connect Co., Ltd., Konica Minolta Information Systems Co., Ltd., Konica Minolta Holdings U.S.A., Inc. and Konica Minolta (CHINA) Investment Ltd. as the main affiliates of this category, but it does not describe the business of this category itself.
entries.76292700e1caaef9: This business develops, manufactures and sells measuring instruments and other equipment, and provides related solutions and services. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 increased from the previous year. The company explains that, as capital investment in displays by major customers recovered, sales of measuring instruments for light source color increased; measuring instruments for object color performed well with new products; and inspection equipment for automotive exterior measurement also expanded sales to new customers. On the other hand, revenue from measuring instruments applying hyperspectral imaging technology declined because customers postponed investment in the European recycling market.
entries.84d978d667fe8322: This business develops, manufactures and sells industrial and professional lenses and other products. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 increased from the previous year. The company explains that sales of lenses for semiconductor inspection equipment and projectors, which it is focusing on, performed well.
entries.938c2e76beb5efbd: This business develops, manufactures, sells and provides services for medical diagnostic imaging systems such as digital X-ray and ultrasound diagnostic systems, and provides digitalization and networking of medical sites as well as diagnostic services and solutions. Revenue decreased from the previous year in the fiscal year ended March 2026. The company explains that unit sales of digital radiography (DR) were in line with the previous year, and that sales of medical IT grew, mainly in the United States, helped by new products; on the other hand, a decline in demand for X-ray film in China and lower sales of purchased products in Japan had an impact.
entries.a7adbf2bc39dd947: This business handles medical diagnostic imaging systems used in hospitals and other settings, image IoT solutions centered on network cameras, video-related equipment, and products and services for nursing care operations. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥94,547 million, down from ¥106,915 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025. The company cites the impact of advancing its selection and focus of businesses, including the transfer of all shares of MOBOTIX AG.
entries.b17403201cff7372: This business develops, manufactures and sells industrial inkjet heads and other products. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 declined from the previous year. The company explains that the impact was mainly due to lower sales in Europe and China in the sign graphics market.
entries.cd5cf5bbcada728f: This business develops, manufactures and sells multifunction devices and related consumables, and provides related services and solutions. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 declined from the previous year. The company cites as reasons that sales of multifunction devices fell in the United States and other markets, and OEM sales also declined, and that consumables and services fell in the United States and other markets due to a decrease in the number of installed units in the market.
entries.e0f51f1fab417a25: This segment brings together the development, manufacture and sale of multifunction devices (machines that combine several functions, such as copying and printing, in one unit) used in offices and related consumables, the provision of related services and solutions, and the provision of IT services and solutions. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥610,504 million, the largest business within consolidated revenue of ¥1,087,738 million. This was slightly down from ¥616,365 million for the fiscal year ended March 2025.
entries.e60c0ccc597321d2: This business provides solutions and services centered on network cameras, and develops, manufactures and sells solutions and provides services that utilize the common platform technology FORXAI. Revenue decreased from the previous year in the fiscal year ended March 2026. The company explains that the impact came from its progress in selecting and concentrating its businesses, including the transfer of all shares it held in MOBOTIX AG. From the fiscal year ended March 2026, the FORXAI Unit is presented as integrated into this unit.
